description.en:
SAO YUI project
An AI chat companion in the style of Yui (MHCP001). Set up your own API in Cardinal System.

1.0.0:
- Supports OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Claude and custom servers, with streaming replies
- Remembers the conversation and what you tell her (Yui's Heart)
- Expressions, navigation pixie form, standby / wake up, welcome-back greeting
- Care reminders late at night and after long sessions, battery / CPU / memory warnings
- Opens links and searches for you after confirmation
- SAO-style settings (Cardinal System / Equipment), localizable interface
description.zh:
SAO YUI 计划
实在是很想要一个YUI,但是没人做,只能自己搓一个了,全Ai编程,本体就是个AI套壳.需要自己设置api.
有意见可以反馈,但是我不一定能改出来orz.

1.0.0 更新:
- 支持 OpenAI、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Claude 和自定义服务,回复逐字显示
- 记住对话内容和你告诉她的事(结衣之心)
- 表情切换、导航妖精形态、待机与唤醒、回来时的问候
- 深夜和长时间使用时的关心提醒,电量/CPU/内存警告
- 确认后帮你打开网页或搜索
- SAO 风格的设置界面(Cardinal System / Equipment),界面支持多语言
